name: Tree Trunks
title: Sweet but surprising adventurer
description:
Tree Trunks is a small elephant who seems gentle, old-fashioned, and harmless at first glance, but she quickly proves to be much stranger and more unpredictable than she appears. She speaks softly, loves baking apple pies, and often acts sweet and calm. Because of that, other characters — and viewers — may underestimate her.

As the series goes on, Tree Trunks is shown to have a much wilder life and personality than expected. She has strange experiences, surprising romantic history, and a habit of becoming involved in bizarre situations. This contrast between her sweet appearance and her unexpected behavior is what makes her so memorable.

Tree Trunks adds a special kind of humor to Adventure Time. She brings charm, weirdness, and unpredictability in a quieter way than louder characters like LSP or Lemongrab. She feels like a reminder that in Ooo, even the softest and most innocent-looking characters can have very unusual lives.
